lattice.comment: Type of lattice to create the initial particles (default=1)

rhopgradient.comment: Initial density gradient 1:Rhop0, 2:Water column, 3:Max. water height (default=2)

hswl.comment: Maximum height of still water to calculate speedofsound using coefsound

gamma.comment: Polytropic constant for water used in the state equation

speedsystem.comment: Maximum system speed (by default the dam-break propagation is used)

speedsound.comment: Speed of sound to use in the simulation (by default speedofsound=coefsound*speedsystem)

coefh.comment: Coefficient to calculate the smoothing length (h=coefh*sqrt(3*dp^2) in 3D)

_hdp.comment: Alternative option to calculate the smoothing length (h=hdp*dp)

maxdisth.comment: Maximum distance to boundary limit. It uses H*maxdisth (default=2)

savevtkpart.comment: Creates VTK files for each PART (default=false)

_computetime.comment: Start and end of measures. (default=simulation time)

_outputtime.comment: Start and end of output measures. (default=simulation time)

vec3.comment: Third axis vector to define the measurement grid (used for elevation calculation)

size3.comment: Length and distance between measurement points for third direction

dirdat.comment: Direction vector for computed linear velocity or other variables

outputdata.comment: Type of results requested (vel, veldir, rhop, zsurf)

_masslimit.comment: Coefficient to calculate mass of free-surface (default=0.5 on 3D and 0.4 on 2D)

_kclimit.comment: Minimum value of sum_wab_vol to apply the Kernel Correction. Use NONE to disable (default=0.5)

_kcdummy.comment: Dummy value for non-corrected values. Use NONE to disable (default=0)
